The following events took place in '''80 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] refugees establish [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[New Ator]], an agriworld in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], is founded by colonists from [[Ator/Legends|Ator]].
*The chronicler [[Succate]] encountered the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]] in the ruins of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhand]], in the [[Nihil Retreat]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
